messages:
Maya: Quick runbook question — seeing a small regression after switching to quant v2 on a dedicated pool. Anyone able to own a short sanity checklist?
Chris: I can take the runbook edits. What are the symptoms?
Maya: 500ms spikes on long sequences (~2k tokens) after cache warm. Trace shows repeated `kv_cache_miss` then worker OOM in a narrow window.
Ashwin: Hmm could be kernel fallback to FP32 for >1024 seq. Which quant/compile flags did you use?
Maya: We rolled with `--quant-mode=dynamic` per the recent optkit guide. Model is `redwood/large-q4`. Deploy snippet: ```sh
rdserve --model redwood/large-q4 --quant-mode dynamic --batch-size 32 --cache-prefix true
```
Elena: Can you paste the exact deploy command + any custom envs? Also link to the telemetry alert.
Maya: Telemetry link: https://grafana.company/alert/ab12cd — spikes align with canary traffic at ~11:45 UTC. No extra envs besides `RD_CACHE_SIZE=1g`.
Chris: Two quick runbook actions: 1) add a repro smoke for seq>1024 and attach the log snippet, 2) escalate kernel-selection check to eng-runtime. I'll add a rollback step that pins previous quant profile. Assigning kernel check to @Ashwin.
Ashwin: I'll inspect kernel table and compile logs. If fallback is happening we can try forcing quant kernel with `KERNEL_FORCE=qat` to validate. Also will check if cache sizing causes eviction thrash.
Maya: Noted. Also saw a regression alert ID `reg-2026-032`. Pasting sample trace in runbook helps.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started by Chris — canary id c-20260318-7 (12:02 UTC).
Chris: Draft runbook uploaded: https://docs.internal/runbooks/quant-longseq-sanity. Short checklist at top (repro, flags, rollback). Please review.
Ashwin: Reviewing now, left inline comment to add `KERNEL_FORCE` experiment and an extra `kv_cache` metric to the smoke.
Elena: If kernel forcing fixes it, plan B is to canary older quant profile for seq>1024. I'll own rollback policy & monitor alerts.
Maya: Timeline: patch + runbook edits by EOD, canary tomorrow AM. If we can’t stabilize, we'll revert canary to previous profile.
Chris: Tagging @eng-runtime for visibility and request for kernel table dump from the canary hosts.
eng-runtime: Got it. We'll collect kernel-selection logs, kernel table, and a quick perf diff within ~2 hours and post here.
Maya: Thanks — please paste any `trace_id` you find so we can correlate with telemetry. :thumbsup:
Chris: Small ask for reviewers: quick lgtm on the runbook top checklist once you confirm repro steps. Keep comments short — we want to ship the fix fast.
Ashwin: Will do. Starting kernel checks now.
Elena: I'll set up an alert mute window during the canary and document the revert steps.
Maya: Appreciated, team. I'll add the log snippet to the runbook and tag you when ready.
